critical_code_review_comments: server.py _detect_columns: header detection uses substring 'test' as a name-column keyword, so a positional CSV whose first data row contains 'TEST_...' in the name column may be misidentified as a header. Not a refactor regression (behaviour matches pre-refactor), but worth guarding by requiring at least one column keyword to match on a row whose cells are non-numeric.
InstrumentCompare.jsx (per iter5): Select value={value || undefined} still causes controlled<->uncontrolled toggle on first render; prefer value={value ?? ''}. Not a regression from this iteration.
